note: Reviewed task-specific strings in code that no prompt reads. `coder-one contamination check` ignores exactly these strings in exactly these files; any other match in the same file is still a finding. Add an entry only for code that selects, labels, or reports runs offline, and say why no model can read it.

exempt.reason: checks::labeled::TARGETS, the recall study's target tasks. `coder-one checks` summarizes labeled rows by it offline; no episode or prompt reads it.
checks::recover::TASKS, which parses a retained job's name to find its task when scenarios are recovered offline; no episode or prompt reads it.
